## Plugin reference

- Description: Side-by-side diff of a changed file vs its checkout's base — a contextual tab, offered only when the host passes git context (checkout, path, status) with a non-clean status, wherever the file's bytes are read from.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `FileViewer.Renderer` "Diff" → `FileDiffView`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/diff-view.DiffOrImageView`
    - `primitives/file-viewer.FileViewer`
